title: PoE2 Acts 1–4 Boss and Permanent Rewards Checklist
summary: A campaign companion for separating mandatory bosses, optional permanent rewards and commonly missed quest items across Acts 1–4.
description: PoE2 Acts 1–4 campaign checklist covering boss order, permanent Life, Spirit, resistance and Weapon Set rewards, and when to return for missed objectives.

seo.title: PoE2 Acts 1–4 Boss and Permanent Rewards Checklist
seo.description: Track PoE2 Acts 1–4 bosses and permanent rewards: Life, Spirit, resistances, Weapon Set points, optional objectives and missed rewards.

items.title: What counts as complete?
body: The boss or quest is finished and any dropped reward item has been consumed or handed to the correct NPC.

items.title: What should I prioritise?
body: Passive points, Weapon Set Passive points, Spirit, maximum Life and permanent resistances before optional loot-only detours.

items.title: Can I return later?
body: Usually yes. Use the Waypoint, finish the objective, then verify that the reward state changed.

items.title: Why can a killed boss still be incomplete?
body: Some permanent rewards come from a dropped consumable or a follow-up quest hand-in rather than the kill flag alone.

sections.title: How to use this guide
paragraphs: This is a completion workflow for Acts 1–4, not a claim that every optional boss gives permanent power. The important distinction is mandatory story progression, optional permanent rewards, and optional loot encounters that can safely wait.

Campaign routing and reward values can change during Early Access. Use the world-map reward icon and the linked current reward table as the final check, especially after a patch or alternate campaign path.

sections.title: Progression framework
sections.caption: Progression framework for the current article topic.

cells.column-2: Beira of the Rotten Pack; The Crowbell; King in the Mists; Una's Lute; Candlemass
cells.column-3: Cold resistance, passive points, Spirit, passive points, maximum Life
cells.column-4: Consume dropped items and complete the associated quest hand-ins; do not leave Freythorn before confirming the Spirit reward.

cells.column-2: Kabala; Final Letter; Ancient Vows; Garukhan Sisters
cells.column-3: Passive points, passive points, a permanent choice, lightning resistance
cells.column-4: Ancient Vows is a choice: read the current reward before committing rather than following an old recommendation.

cells.column-2: Mighty Silverfist; Sacrificial Heart; Ignagduk; Venom Draught
cells.column-3: Passive or Weapon Set points, fire resistance, and a permanent choice
cells.column-4: Some rewards require an item interaction or NPC step after the boss.

cells.column-2: Journey's End; Halls of the Dead; Trail of the Ancestors; Abandoned Prison; Whakapanu Island
cells.column-3: +2 Weapon Set Passive Points at Journey's End; three trial tattoo choices; +5% maximum Mana at Navali's Rest; +2 passive points from the completed trial; a flask-recovery choice; a permanent defense choice
cells.column-4: Complete the post-boss hand-ins: free Freya, speak to Hinekora, and confirm each tattoo or permanent choice before leaving the island chain.

sections.title: Decision matrix
sections.caption: Decision matrix for the current article topic.

cells.column-4: Verify the passive-point total changed after consuming or handing in the reward.
These points are not ordinary global passive points.
Confirm the quest reward was actually granted.
Small permanent bonuses compound with later defenses.
Do not use it as an excuse to ignore gear caps.
A choice can be harder to reverse than an ordinary gear mistake.

sections.title: Scenario recommendations
sections.caption: Scenario recommendations for the current article topic.

cells.column-3: Mark permanent rewards to revisit before mapping
cells.column-4: Do not rely on memory after changing acts.

cells.column-2: Prioritise King in the Mists and other current Spirit rewards
cells.column-4: A kill without the reward step may leave the build unchanged.

cells.column-2: Complete Beira, Garukhan and Ignagduk-type permanent objectives
cells.column-3: Then fix remaining caps on gear
cells.column-4: Permanent bonuses supplement rather than replace equipment.

cells.column-2: Use Waypoints and clear only missing reward objectives
cells.column-4: Check the world map and passive totals before leaving.

sections.title: Practical workflow
sections.intro: Run the process in order and preserve a rollback point before spending heavily.

cards.title: Step 1
body: Open the act world map and inspect every reward-bearing icon before moving to the next act.

cards.title: Step 2
body: Classify each objective as mandatory, permanent reward, choice reward, or loot only.

cards.title: Step 3
body: After the kill, pick up quest items and read them; right-click consumables or return them to the named NPC as instructed.

cards.title: Step 4
body: Verify the character sheet, passive total, Spirit total, or quest state rather than trusting the boss corpse alone.

cards.title: Step 5
body: At the end of Act 4, compare the current character against the linked quest-reward table and revisit any missing entries.

sections.title: Common mistakes and fixes
sections.intro: These failures cost more time than a small difference between two reasonable choices.

cards.title: Leaving after the kill
body: Why it fails: The permanent reward may be a consumable or hand-in.
Do this: Finish the quest step and verify the stat.

cards.title: Following an old reward value
body: Why it fails: Early Access campaign rewards can move or change.
Do this: Use the current world map and database.

cards.title: Confusing passive-point types
body: Why it fails: Weapon Set points do not behave like ordinary passive points.
Do this: Check the allocation interface before planning the tree.

cards.title: Picking a permanent choice blindly
body: Why it fails: The popular option may not fit the current build.
Do this: Read both effects in the current client.

items.question: Do I need every optional boss?
answer: No. Prioritise bosses and quests that grant permanent character power; loot-only encounters can wait.

items.question: Can the world map be trusted?
answer: It is the best current in-client indicator, but verify the reward was consumed or handed in.

items.question: Are Cruel and alternate-act rewards identical?
answer: Do not assume so during Early Access. Check the current campaign route and reward table for the character.

items.question: What should I check before maps?
answer: Passive totals, Weapon Set points, Spirit, permanent Life and resistance rewards, plus any unresolved choice reward.

items.question: Why does the checklist avoid some exact values?
answer: Values and Act 4 routing have changed; where a current primary or database record is not stable, the guide gives a verification method instead of inventing precision.
